node.label: West Asia: Iran war & Hormuz
node.summary: The Iran war, the Strait of Hormuz blockade and the Houthis.

facts.text: Iran reported **two more** tankers and a tugboat caught fire in the **Strait of Hormuz**; the UK's UKMTO reported a tanker hit by projectiles off Qatar.
facts.plain: Iran reported two more tankers and a tugboat caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz; the UK's UKMTO reported a tanker hit by projectiles off Qatar.

facts.text: The US Treasury imposed fresh sanctions on firms in **India and Türkiye** for allegedly aiding Iran, under its **'Operation Economic Outcast'** campaign.
facts.plain: The US Treasury imposed fresh sanctions on firms in India and Türkiye for allegedly aiding Iran, under its 'Operation Economic Outcast' campaign.

facts.text: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said **four oil tankers** caught fire after striking naval mines while trying to cross the **Strait of Hormuz** without authorisation; two more vessels were halted and a US-made drone was shot down.
facts.plain: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said four oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines while trying to cross the Strait of Hormuz without authorisation; two more vessels were halted and a US-made drone was shot down.

facts.text: Iran: President **Masoud Pezeshkian** said a return to war benefits 'no one'; chief negotiator with the US: **Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf**; Deputy FM: **Kazem Gharibabadi**. **Qatar** is the mediator.
facts.plain: Iran: President Masoud Pezeshkian said a return to war benefits 'no one'; chief negotiator with the US: Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf; Deputy FM: Kazem Gharibabadi. Qatar is the mediator.

facts.text: The **'Mecca Agreement'** alliance of **Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan** (signed August 2026) sent defence and intelligence chiefs, including Pakistan Army chief **Asim Munir**, to Tehran in October; Iran's side was led by SNSC head **Mohsen Rezaei**.
facts.plain: The 'Mecca Agreement' alliance of Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan (signed August 2026) sent defence and intelligence chiefs, including Pakistan Army chief Asim Munir, to Tehran in October; Iran's side was led by SNSC head Mohsen Rezaei.

facts.text: US strikes hit **Qeshm island** at the mouth of the **Strait of Hormuz**, raising oil prices. Qeshm is the **largest island in the Persian Gulf** (Iran).
facts.plain: US strikes hit Qeshm island at the mouth of the Strait of Hormuz, raising oil prices. Qeshm is the largest island in the Persian Gulf (Iran).
keys: largest island in the Persian Gulf

facts.text: An Indian seafarer, **Gandhar Nahim Ajij** (Gujarat), was killed when a drone hit the vessel **MSV Al Jusufi** off **Oman**; 13 Indians were rescued by Oman's navy. This took Indian seafarer deaths since the West Asia war began (Feb 2026) to **23**. MEA spokesperson: **Randhir Jaiswal**.
facts.plain: An Indian seafarer, Gandhar Nahim Ajij (Gujarat), was killed when a drone hit the vessel MSV Al Jusufi off Oman; 13 Indians were rescued by Oman's navy. This took Indian seafarer deaths since the West Asia war began (Feb 2026) to 23. MEA spokesperson: Randhir Jaiswal.

facts.text: India link: Hormuz carries much of India's oil and LNG; the war hit Qatar LNG supplies and airline fuel costs.
facts.plain: India link: Hormuz carries much of India's oil and LNG; the war hit Qatar LNG supplies and airline fuel costs.

facts.text: Yemen's **Houthis** claimed a drone attack on Saudi Arabia's **Dammam airport**.
facts.plain: Yemen's Houthis claimed a drone attack on Saudi Arabia's Dammam airport.

facts.text: Iran's Foreign Minister: **Abbas Araghchi**; spokesman: **Esmaeil Baqaei**.
facts.plain: Iran's Foreign Minister: Abbas Araghchi; spokesman: Esmaeil Baqaei.

facts.text: Iran says it can reopen the **Strait of Hormuz** within two days if the US meets its terms. Hormuz has been blockaded since the war began in **February 2026**.
facts.plain: Iran says it can reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if the US meets its terms. Hormuz has been blockaded since the war began in February 2026.

facts.text: Iran warned that any renewed war with the US 'could last longer' than the previous round, after President Trump said he had to 'take care of' more targets; Iran's Revolutionary Guards said a future conflict would have 'no geographic limitations'.
facts.plain: Iran warned that any renewed war with the US 'could last longer' than the previous round, after President Trump said he had to 'take care of' more targets; Iran's Revolutionary Guards said a future conflict would have 'no geographic limitations'.

facts.text: Iran's Supreme Leader **Mojtaba Khamenei** (in charge since March after his father **Ali Khamenei** was killed in US-Israeli strikes) warned of a 'geographically unrestricted' response; Trump is weighing action after the **US midterms**, and Netanyahu spoke of a chance to topple Tehran. Armed forces chief: **Ali Abdollahi**; IRGC: **Ahmad Vahidi**.
facts.plain: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei (in charge since March after his father Ali Khamenei was killed in US-Israeli strikes) warned of a 'geographically unrestricted' response; Trump is weighing action after the US midterms, and Netanyahu spoke of a chance to topple Tehran. Armed forces chief: Ali Abdollahi; IRGC: Ahmad Vahidi.

facts.text: **Oman** rescued 25 sailors from the burning Panama-flagged ship **RITI**; Iran halted three tankers. Tehran has restricted traffic in the **Strait of Hormuz** since the West Asia war began on **28 Feb 2026**.
facts.plain: Oman rescued 25 sailors from the burning Panama-flagged ship RITI; Iran halted three tankers. Tehran has restricted traffic in the Strait of Hormuz since the West Asia war began on 28 Feb 2026.

facts.text: Iran's IRGC said **four tankers** caught fire after hitting **mines** in the **Strait of Hormuz**, a day after the US said it had demined key routes.
facts.plain: Iran's IRGC said four tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz, a day after the US said it had demined key routes.
